title: Multiple Classes – SF Lesson List – Multi-Class Lesson Row – Comma-Separated Class Names Displayed
description: AC 05.1 (BR-27) — CRUD Testing — Validates the SF Lesson List Class column shows comma-separated names for a multi-class lesson.
preconditions: - SF flag TRUE\n- Lesson "Lesson MC-01" has 2 LSC records: Class Alpha and Class Beta\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions: 1. Navigate to SF Lessons List\n2. Locate the row for "Lesson MC-01"\n3. Read the Class column value
steps_result: 1. Lesson List displayed\n2. "Lesson MC-01" row visible\n3. Class column shows "Class Alpha, Class Beta"

title: Multiple Classes – SF Calendar Filter – Single Class Selected – Lessons Containing That Class Are Shown
description: AC 05.1 (BR-28) — Decision Table — Validates that filtering SF Calendar by one class shows all lessons containing that class including multi-class lessons.
preconditions: - SF flag TRUE\n- 3 lessons: Lesson 1 (Class Alpha only), Lesson 2 (Class Alpha+Class Beta), Lesson 3 (Class Beta only)\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff; SF Mana Calendar accessible
steps_actions: 1. Navigate to SF Mana Calendar\n2. Apply class filter: select "Class Alpha" only\n3. Observe which lessons are displayed
steps_result: 1. Calendar displayed with all 3 lessons\n2. Filter applied: Class Alpha only\n3. Lesson 1 and Lesson 2 shown; Lesson 3 hidden

title: Multiple Classes – SF Calendar Filter – Two Classes Selected – ALL-Match Logic Shows Only Lessons with Both Classes
description: BR-35 — Decision Table (Deep) — Validates the SF Calendar ALL-match filter: selecting two classes shows only lessons containing BOTH.
preconditions: - SF flag TRUE\n- 3 lessons: Lesson 1 (Class Alpha), Lesson 2 (Class Alpha+Class Beta), Lesson 3 (Class Beta)\n- SF Mana Calendar accessible
steps_actions: 1. Navigate to SF Mana Calendar\n2. Apply class filter: select both "Class Alpha" and "Class Beta"\n3. Observe which lessons are displayed
steps_result: 1. Calendar displayed\n2. Both classes selected\n3. Only Lesson 2 shown; Lesson 1 (Alpha only) and Lesson 3 (Beta only) hidden
steps_data: 1. "\n2. Filter: Class Alpha AND Class Beta\n3. "

title: Multiple Classes – SF Calendar Filter – Two Classes with No Common Lesson – No Lessons Displayed
description: BR-35 — Decision Table (Deep) — Validates ALL-match returns no results when no lesson has all selected classes.
preconditions: - SF flag TRUE\n- Lesson 2 has Class Alpha+Class Beta; no lesson has Class Alpha+Class Gamma\n- SF Mana Calendar accessible
steps_actions: 1. Navigate to SF Mana Calendar\n2. Apply class filter: select "Class Alpha" and "Class Gamma"\n3. Observe results
steps_result: 1. Calendar displayed\n2. Both classes selected\n3. No lessons shown (no lesson contains BOTH Class Alpha AND Class Gamma)
steps_data: 1. "\n2. Filter: Class Alpha AND Class Gamma\n3. "
